model.title: Brian Head Town Land Conveyance Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Mike Lee (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would transfer about 24 acres of National Forest System land within the Dixie National Forest in Utah, along with any improvements on it, from the federal government to Brian Head Town at no cost. The town would have to use the land to develop and expand public safety infrastructure and a public works facility, and to expand public recreational access within the town. The Forest Service would then adjust the boundary of the Dixie National Forest to reflect the transfer. If the Secretary of Agriculture, after consulting with the State of Utah, finds the town used the land for a purpose the bill does not allow, the land would return to the United States at the Secretary's discretion. Before making that finding, the Secretary would have to notify the town, offer a hearing if the town asks for one, provide public notice and comment, and give the town a reasonable chance to correct the problem.
